title: Enterprise Ask Orchestra: intake bundling and rapid-scope seed
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Problem statement: Sales and Customer Success are sending dispersed enterprise feature requests that vary wildly in fidelity. PMs spend significant time normalizing asks before technical scoping, which delays responses and increases risk of over-committing engineering. Goal: produce a lightweight, repeatable intake + initial-scope process (the 'Orchestra' flow) that batches related enterprise asks, scores them for value/effort/risk, and emits a 1-page initial scope artifact within 5 business days.

Scope: this ticket defines the orchestration rules, templates, and tooling hooks (CRM -> Linear -> PM dashboard) required for the initial-stage funnel only (not final PRD). Deliverables: 1) intake bundler ruleset; 2) scoring rubric and default weights; 3) initial-scope template (1 page) and checklist; 4) mapping of outputs to next-step owners (Solutions Eng, Product, Eng) and suggested SLAs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Bundler groups related requests by product area, customer persona, and problem statement using text clustering + tag heuristics.
- Scorecard produces a ranked list with Reasoning fields: revenue opportunity estimate, integration surface, regulatory constraints, engineering rough size (T-shirt), and known dependencies.
- PMs can generate a 1-page initial scope PDF from a template and attach to the Linear issue within 5 business days of intake.
- The flow integrates with CRM (Salesforce) and CS (Gong/Intercom) to annotate customer quotes and link the originating thread.

Non-goals: this ticket does not implement automatic engineering estimates beyond T-shirt sizes, nor final release planning/roadmapping.

Notes on trade-offs and heuristics:
- Prioritization weights: revenue (40%), strategic-fit (25%), implementation-risk (20%), time-to-value (15%). We propose starting weights and plan an A/B test against historical closes to tune.
- Clustering: use a lightweight n-gram + embedding similarity pass. Avoid heavy ML infra to keep latency low; fall back to manual tag overrides.
- SLA tension: 5 business days for initial scope is aggressive; propose 3-day SLA for tiered/high-enterprise customers and 7 days for low-priority bundles.

Integration and artifacts:
- Confluence PRD template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/Enterprise+Orchestra+Template
- Drive folder for initial-scope PDFs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcOrchestra
- GitHub repo for helper scripts (clustering/scorecard): https://github.com/redwood-inference/orchestra-intake
- Dashboard mock: https://datastudio.redwood.ai/orchestra-intake-mock

Next steps: convene working session with Solutions Eng and Head of CS to validate scoring heuristics; prototype bundler on a 30-day backlog slice; iterate on template language after 3 pilot cases.
